```json
 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current, so energy is about the switched capacitance times VDD^2. At 1.98 V, 210 fJ allows about 53 fF; the design targets about 30 fF using small L=0.15 devices. The 1 ns evaluate window gives ample time: about 100-150 ps typical, about 3x slower at ss/125C/1.62V. The PMOS latch overdrive (VDD-|Vth|~0.6 V at worst) is the limiter. Output inverters isolate CL from the latch. All internal nodes are reset to VDD."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # input pair width (um), L=Lmin -> sets initial integration gm
    "Wtail": (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # clocked tail switch width (um)
    "Wnl":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),    # cross-coupled NMOS latch width
    "Wpl":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),    # cross-coupled PMOS latch width
    "Wrst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset PMOS width
    "Wbn":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter NMOS width
    "Wbp":   (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),   # output inverter PMOS width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], L)
    # input pair: vinp > vinn -> x discharges faster -> lp falls -> outp high
    n.M("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    n.M("M2", "y", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], L)
    # cross-coupled NMOS (sources on integration nodes)
    n.M("M3", "lp", "ln", "x", "vss", "nfet", p["Wnl"], L)
    n.M("M4", "ln", "lp", "y", "vss", "nfet", p["Wnl"], L)
    # cross-coupled PMOS
    n.M("M5", "lp", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wpl"], L)
    n.M("M6", "ln", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wpl"], L)
    # reset switches on all internal nodes (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "lp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "ln", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "x", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "y", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    # output inverters (reset: lp=ln=VDD -> outp=outn=0)
    n.M("MBN1", "outp", "lp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbn"], L)
    n.M("MBP1", "outp", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wbp"], L)
    n.M("MBN2", "outn", "ln", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wbn"], L)
    n.M("MBP2", "outn", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wbp"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cpu = 1.6e-15  # gate+junction cap per um width (approx, L=0.15)
    c_x = cpu * (0.6 * p["Win"] + p["Wnl"] + 0.5 * p["Wrst"])
    c_l = cpu * (p["Wnl"] + 2 * p["Wpl"] + 0.5 * p["Wrst"] + 0.6 * p["Wnl"]
                 + p["Wbn"] + p["Wbp"])
    c_tail = cpu * (0.5 * p["Wtail"] + p["Win"])
    # switched capacitance per comparison: both x,y and both l nodes discharge (~fully / partially),
    # one output node toggles, plus tail and buffer internal caps
    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 1.3 * c_l + c_tail + cl + cpu * (p["Wbn"] + p["Wbp"])
    energy = c_sw * 1.98 ** 2

    # integration phase: input pair discharges x,y by ~Vthn so NMOS latch turns on
    tail = lut.op("n", p["Wtail"], L, vgs=vdd, vds=0.2)
    m_in = lut.op("n", p["Win"], L, vgs=0.9 - 0.15, vds=0.6)
    I = min(tail["Id"], 2 * m_in["Id"]) if tail["Id"] > 0 else 2 * m_in["Id"]
    t_int = (2 * c_x) * 0.65 / max(I, 1e-6) + (2 * c_l) * 0.4 / max(I, 1e-6)
    # regeneration
    mn = lut.op("n", p["Wnl"], L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.6)
    mp = lut.op("p", p["Wpl"], L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.6)
    gm_l = mn["gm"] + mp["gm"]
    av = max(2.0, (m_in["gm_id"] if m_in["gm_id"] > 0 else 10) * 0.65 / 2)
    t_reg = c_l / max(gm_l, 1e-6) * math.log(vdd / (av * dv))
    t_buf = 0.69 * (cl + cpu * 2 * p["Wbn"]) * 3e3 / max(p["Wbn"], 0.42)
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_buf

    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
```
